title: Buck Charlson, inventor of power steering and the Gerotor, backs Mishlove's work

tellings.quote: another major supporter of my work was a fellow named Buck Charlesson who invented power steering.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychics, UFOs and the afterlife, says one of his major backers was Buck Charlson, the Minnesota inventor of power steering and of the Gerotor, a kind of pump. Mishlove tells it himself, as proof that a hard-headed engineer supported his work on the unexplained.
